therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with advanced solid tumors (Small Cell Lung Cancer, Soft Tissue Sarcoma, Triple-negative Breast Cancer, Ovarian Cancer, Endometrial Cancer)
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Safety (Phase 1) and Clinical Benefit Response Rate (Phase 2)

results.target_engagement_evidence: Pharmacokinetic data showed drug exposure with Cmax ranging 1150-1620 ng/mL and measurable metabolites M2 and M8
subgroup_findings: Variable clinical benefit rates across tumor types
Objective response rate in Sub Study 1: 16.7%
No objective responses in SCLC cohort
safety_signals: General disorders and administration site conditions
Cardiac events including myocardial infarction and cardiac arrest
results.dose_information: 60-100 mg/m2 IV over 30-80 minutes on Days 1 and 15 of 28-day cycles
